import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAXN = 32;
    static int k;
    static long n;

    static class Matrix {
        int N;
        int[][] a = new int[MAXN][MAXN];

        void init(int _N, int _V) {
            N = _N;
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(a[i], _V);
            }
        }

        void multiply(Matrix b) {
            int[][] temp = new int[N][N];
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                    long t = 0;
                    for (int k_ = 0; k_ < N; k_++) {
                        t += (long) a[i][k_] * b.a[k_][j];
                    }
                    temp[i][j] = (int) (t % MOD);
                }
            }
            a = temp;
        }
    }

    static Matrix[][] A = new Matrix[64][32];
    static Matrix[][] prefix = new Matrix[64][32];
    static Matrix[][] suffix = new Matrix[64][32];

    static void precompute(int idx) {
        prefix[idx][1] = A[idx][0];
        for (int j = 2; j <= k; j++) {
            prefix[idx][j] = new Matrix();
            prefix[idx][j].init(k + 1, 0);
            prefix[idx][j].a = Arrays.copyOf(prefix[idx][j - 1].a, prefix[idx][j - 1].a.length);
            prefix[idx][j].multiply(A[idx][j - 1]);
        }
        suffix[idx][k - 1] = A[idx][k - 1];
        for (int j = k - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
            suffix[idx][j] = new Matrix();
            suffix[idx][j].init(k + 1, 0);
            suffix[idx][j].a = Arrays.copyOf(A[idx][j].a, A[idx][j].a.length);
            suffix[idx][j].multiply(suffix[idx][j + 1]);
        }
    }

    static int sumDigits(long num) {
        int s = 0;
        while (num > 0) {
            s = (s + (int) (num % k)) % k;
            num /= k;
        }
        return s;
    }

    static Matrix getResult(long num, int m) {
        if (num < k) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix();
            res.init(k + 1, 0);
            res.a = Arrays.copyOf(A[m][0].a, A[m][0].a.length);
            for (int i = 1; i < num; i++) {
                res.multiply(A[m][i]);
            }
            return res;
        }
        Matrix res = getResult(num / k, m + 1);
        int x = sumDigits(num / k);
        for (int i = 0; i < num % k; i++) {
            res.multiply(A[m][(x + i) % k]);
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        k = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 32; j++) {
                A[i][j] = new Matrix();
                A[i][j].init(k + 1, 0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                A[0][i].a[j][j] = 1;
                A[0][i].a[j][i] = 1;
            }
        }

        int m = 1;
        while (pow(k, m) - 1000 <= n) {
            precompute(m - 1);
            for (int x = 0; x < k; x++) {
                A[m][x] = new Matrix();
                A[m][x].init(k + 1, 0);
                A[m][x].a = Arrays.copyOf(suffix[m - 1][x].a, suffix[m - 1][x].a.length);
                if (x > 0) {
                    A[m][x].multiply(prefix[m - 1][x]);
                }
            }
            m++;
        }

        Matrix answerMat = getResult(n, 0);
        int totalSum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            totalSum = (totalSum + answerMat.a[k][i]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(totalSum);
        sc.close();
    }

    static long pow(int base, int exp) {
        long result = 1;
        long b = base;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result *= b;
            }
            b *= b;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
